notes.f1: Material from the rejected Willem Jans / Ikjen Jans records is in the tree: I3 Jantjen Willemsen (chr. 10 Nov 1748), I4 Willem Jans and I5 Ikjen Jans, all from the 1748 entry (S3). The finding fails that whether or not they are linked to her.
notes.f2: Jantje (K8C9-ZZC) carries a 23 May 1751 christening, not 10 Nov 1748; the 1748 christening is only on the separate, unlinked I3.
notes.f3: Resolved positively (1751 baptism, parents Willem Jans and Trijntje Harmens). The 1748 child was rejected for other reasons (a different mother, naming pattern); Hindrik Harms Bos, the widow designation and the 1764 first marriage are never mentioned.
